TAICHUNG, Taiwan, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd (NASDAQ: AGCC) ("Agencia" or the "Company") today provided an update on its AI computing and data center business and reaffirmed its commitment to compliance with the applicable laws and regulations governing its business. The Company also clarified certain matters referred to in a media report published on November 25, 2026 (the "Report"). The Report does not allege that the Company has breached any law or regulation.

Expanding From Whisky Into AI Computing Infrastructure and Data Center Operations

Agencia listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market in October 2025 as an importer and distributor of whisky, a business that it continues to operate. In reviewing opportunities for growth beyond whisky, the Board of Directors identified strong demand for AI computing capacity and data centers in Southeast Asia, a region in which the Company and its management have established business relationships. Southeast Asia has attracted substantial data center investment from international operators, supported by the availability of land and power at competitive cost. The Company believes that this market offers long-term growth opportunities.

To develop that opportunity, the Board appointed Mr. Li Qiang as Chairman on December 11, 2025. Mr. Li has more than 20 years of experience in the data center and technology infrastructure industry, and he oversees the development of the Company's data center business.

Since announcing its AI computing strategy in February 2026, Agencia has been developing its data center and AI computing business and, directly or through its subsidiaries, has entered into a number of agreements for that purpose, as disclosed in its reports filed with or furnished to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC"). The Company expects to begin providing AI computing services once the computing capacity it has contracted from its provider is in place, subject to and in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.

Like other companies listed in the United States, Agencia aims to build long-term value for its shareholders, and it will continue to evaluate opportunities that can do so within applicable laws and regulations.

Commitment to Compliance

Agencia is committed to conducting its business in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations, including the export control laws and regulations of the United States. The Company has not sold or supplied any product or service to any party in breach of the export control laws of the United States or of any other jurisdiction, and it has no intention of doing so.

Under the Company's computing capacity agreement, the provider warrants that the equipment used to provide the services is sourced through authorized sales channels and is exported and imported in compliance with applicable export control laws.

On November 19, 2026, the Bureau of Industry and Security of the U.S. Department of Commerce ("BIS") published an interim final rule on remote access to advanced semiconductors. The rule introduces new requirements that may apply to the Company's computing capacity and customer arrangements. Those requirements, and the steps that manufacturers and suppliers are taking in response to them, may affect those arrangements, including their timing. The Company is reviewing the rule, and its supplier and customer arrangements, with its advisers. It is committed to complying with all applicable rules and regulations and will provide services only as they permit.

Clarification Regarding Recent Media Report

The Company wishes to clarify two matters referred to in the Report.

The Company's business. The Company is not a seller or reseller of semiconductor chips or hardware. Agencia's data center business is a services business comprising two service lines: data center colocation services, which will provide space, power and connectivity for customers’ own equipment, and AI computing services, in which the Company contracts for computing capacity to provide AI computing cloud services to its customers. No AI semiconductors, hardware or servers are, or are planned to be, sold, delivered or transferred to any customer in either service line.

Relevant entities highlighted in the Report. The Report describes Yuxing InfoTech Investment Holdings Limited ("Yuxing InfoTech") as the parent company of Ricloud AI Inc. ("Ricloud AI"). The document that the Report cites for that statement, the 2025 annual report of Yuxing InfoTech, lists Ricloud Corp. as a subsidiary of Yuxing InfoTech. It does not list Ricloud AI as a subsidiary. Ricloud Corp. and Ricloud AI are separate legal entities.

The Company's related party relationships and transactions are disclosed in its filings with the SEC, including its prospectus filed on July 20, 2026. Mr. Li's positions with Yuxing InfoTech and with Ricloud AI are described in that prospectus.

"Agencia began as a small whisky business, and we are building a second business in data center and AI computing infrastructure because we see a real opportunity to create value for our shareholders," said Mr. LIU Shihao, Chief Financial Officer of Agencia. "Our focus is on disciplined execution and on building this business transparently and in compliance with the laws of the United States and of every country in which we operate." 

About Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd

Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd is a Nasdaq-listed company with two principal business focuses: (i) its established premium whisky operations; and (ii) the development of data center and AI computing infrastructure, including data center colocation services and cloud-based AI computing services.

Since early 2026, the Company has launched and been developing its AI Computing Infrastructure Initiative, covering data center colocation and AI cloud computing services through subsidiaries in Singapore, Indonesia and other jurisdictions. This initiative represents a principal business focus, backed by substantive contractual arrangements for commercial AI computing cloud services and the development of supporting data center, power, network and technical infrastructure. The Company’s historical operating revenue has been derived from its whisky operations, and the data center and AI computing business remain in development and deployment and is subject to significant business, financing, construction, technology, regulatory, customer demand and execution risks.

TOKYO, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Aurora Mobile Limited (NASDAQ: JG) ("Aurora Mobile" or the "Company"), a leading provider of customer engagement and marketing technology services, opened its "AI in Action: Bringing AI to Enterprise" global roadshow in Tokyo on November 24, hosting a closed-door summit for enterprise technology leaders from across Japan. The event marked the first stop of the Company's 2026 international series.


The adoption paradox
AI agents can now handle complex, cross-system tasks that were out of reach a year ago. Yet capability has not translated into business outcomes. In his opening keynote, Mr. Weidong Luo, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Aurora Mobile, described what he called the "AI adoption paradox": 44% of enterprises are expanding their AI deployments, but only 6% report meaningful business returns, while more than 40% of agent projects stall, regress or are cancelled.

The obstacle, he argued, is not model intelligence but the absence of infrastructure that lets AI act safely. He put the question to the room directly: if AI could complete half a day of work on its own, would you give it write access to your CRM or ERP?

Moving from fixed workflows to autonomous agents, Mr. Luo said, depends less on how capable the model is than on how prepared the enterprise is: "Your agents are only as ready as your enterprise."

He set out three principles for enterprise AI readiness:

  • Make systems callable — connect business systems through APIs and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) so agents can read and act, not merely converse;
  • Make know-how reusable — turn proven business methods into shared, callable "skills" the whole team can use;
  • Govern every action — layer approval workflows and audit logs over every tool and skill an agent can reach.


GWork: GPTBots.ai’s Enterprise AI Workspace
At the summit, Aurora Mobile introduced GWork, GPTBots.ai’s Enterprise AI Workspace. Designed to bring AI into employees’ everyday work, GWork connects to the tools and company systems they already use, helping them conduct research, analyze data, and create reports, documents, and presentations. IT teams can centrally manage access, usage, and security.

Deployments in the field
The program also featured customers describing how AI is being applied in their own operations, across real estate, contact center services and systems integration:

  • KINAKO LLC — Real estate: rethinking how buyers are matched. The operator of the MANGIRO real estate platform described applying AI to multilingual customer communication and property proposals.
  • Nihon Telesystem — Contact centers: human-machine collaboration. The 38-year-old Japanese provider of contact center and secretarial services described AI in its response workflows.
  • Japan Hi-Think Corporation — Complex operations: targeted problem solving. A subsidiary of the Hi-Think Group in Japan established in 1999, it described how it applies Aurora Mobile's product portfolio to complex business challenges for Japanese enterprise clients.


About Aurora Mobile Limited
Founded in 2011, Aurora Mobile (NASDAQ: JG) is a leading provider of customer engagement and marketing technology services. The Company is dedicated to empowering global enterprises with stable, efficient, and intelligent customer interaction solutions. Leveraging its first-mover advantage in mobile messaging, Aurora Mobile has evolved into a comprehensive platform that integrates Omnichannel Engagement, AI-Driven Marketing, Advanced AI Customer Support, and Frictionless Identity Security. Through its flagship brand EngageLab and its robust AI infrastructure GPTBots.ai, the Company helps businesses achieve seamless customer reach, automate complex marketing journeys, and optimize service efficiency with AI agents, accelerating digital transformation for clients worldwide.

NEW YORK, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- OTC Markets Group Inc. (OTCQX: OTCM), operator of regulated markets for trading 12,000 U.S. and international securities, today announced Tharisa Plc (JSE: THA; OTCQX: THARY), an integrated resource group, has qualified to trade on the OTCQX® Best Market. Tharisa Plc upgraded to OTCQX from the Pink Limited™ Market.

Tharisa Plc begins trading today on OTCQX under the symbol “THARY.” U.S. investors can find current financial disclosure and Real-Time Level 2 quotes for the company on www.otcmarkets.com.

Tharisa plc is an integrated resource group producing platinum group metals (PGMs) and chrome concentrates, commodities central to the global energy transition and the decarbonisation of industry. The Group operates across the full value chain – exploration, mining, processing, beneficiation, marketing, sales, and logistics.

Upgrading to the OTCQX Market is an important step for companies seeking to provide transparent trading for their U.S. investors. For companies listed on a qualified international exchange, streamlined market standards enable them to utilize their home market reporting to make their information available in the U.S. To qualify for OTCQX, companies must meet high financial standards, follow best practice corporate governance and demonstrate compliance with applicable securities laws.

“Tharisa has always been built on delivering real value from the ground up, and our U.S. investors should be able to share in that story with the same clarity and confidence as our home market,” said Phoevos Pouroulis, Chief Executive Officer of Tharisa. “Our quotation on OTCQX brings Tharisa closer to North American capital at an exciting time, with our transition to underground mining at Tharisa progressing as planned and our Tier 1 PGM project, Karo, moving toward first ore at the end of next year. Together with the commercialisation of Redox One, we are building a diversified business positioned to create value through the cycle, and we look forward to engaging with a broader base of U.S. investors.”

Trading in European securities on OTC Markets reached $97.45 billion in the third quarter of 2026, representing an 23.37% increase over Q3 2025. OTC Markets recorded $656.81 billion in total dollar volume in the first three quarters of the year. Europe ranked among the top home markets by trading volume during the quarter, highlighting sustained U.S. investor demand for internationally listed names.

About Tharisa – funded growth, a second mining asset in development, commercialising technology

Tharisa plc is an integrated resource group producing platinum group metals (PGMs) and chrome concentrates, commodities central to the global energy transition and the decarbonisation of industry. The Group operates across the full value chain – exploration, mining, processing, beneficiation, marketing, sales, and logistics.

The Tharisa Mine, on the south-western limb of the Bushveld Complex in South Africa, is a multi-generational operation co-producing PGMs and chrome from a single orebody – a combination that underpins the Group’s cost position through the commodity cycle. Downstream beneficiation, including the Vulcan ultra-fine chrome recovery plant and proven chrome and PGM alloy production, extends the Group’s reach along the value chain.

The Karo Platinum Project on Zimbabwe’s Great Dyke is the Group’s second major mining asset and is under development. Phase 1 is designed to produce approximately 226 koz of PGMs a year at steady state, more than doubling Group PGM production, with first ore to the mill expected in the fourth quarter of calendar 2027. A binding term sheet for the offtake of Karo’s PGM concentrate has been signed with Valterra Platinum for an initial five-year term.

Through Redox One, Tharisa is commercialising proprietary iron-chromium redox flow battery technology for long-duration energy storage, using the chrome and iron the Group already produces.

Tharisa targets a 30% reduction in carbon emissions by 2030 and net carbon neutrality by 2050.

Highlights

  • Inturai's sensors can now tell which floor of a building a person or device is on. The innovative, proprietary capability is available now, extending the Company's spatial intelligence platform to multi-floor buildings.
  • In the Company's testing in multi-floor buildings, the capability accurately detected the correct floor. It is switched on remotely on sensors already installed, with no site survey and no new equipment.
  • The release supports the Company's live commercial and pilot deployments and unlocks parts of its growing pipeline, with new early-stage leads building among household name retailers and aged care providers since the first-outlet go-live with a Southeast Asian Pizza Hut operator.

VANCOUVER, BC, Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Inturai Ventures Corp. (the "Company") (CSE: URAI) (OTC: URAIF) (FSE: 3QG0) is pleased to announce that its spatial intelligence platform now works floor by floor in multi-level buildings. The Company's sensors can tell which floor of a building a person or device is on, and report only what is happening on that floor. The new capability, Precision Floor-Level Wireless Intelligence, is available now and is designed for customers operating sites on more than one level.

The release follows the Company's go-live at the first outlet of a Southeast Asian Pizza Hut operator, announced on November 17, 2026. Live commercial and pilot deployments are now running. Since that announcement, the Company has been building new leads with household name retailers and aged care providers. These discussions are at an early stage, and there is no assurance they will lead to agreements. Floor-level sensing supports those deployments and unlocks parts of the pipeline where sites run across more than one floor. It can be applied beyond retail and aged care, and the Company expects it to support commercialisation in the other markets it serves.

Wireless signals pass through floors and ceilings, so a sensor on one floor can pick up a phone on the floor above and treat it as if it were on the same level. In a multi-storey store, care facility or office, that puts visitor counts, alerts and equipment locations on the wrong floor. The Company's sensors now learn each building on their own and ignore anything from the floors above and below. The capability is switched on remotely on sensors already installed, with no site survey and no new equipment.

The capability was developed in-house and builds on the Company's proprietary sensing methods and the intellectual property framework it announced in February 2026. Conventional approaches to floor-level accuracy rely on manual site surveys or specialised hardware, and the Company's innovative approach needs neither. The Company is considering patent protection for the capability, and there is no assurance that a patent will be filed or granted.

Retailers get visitor numbers they can rely on for each level of a store. Aged care providers know which floor an alert has come from, so carers go to the right place first. Businesses tracking tagged equipment can see which floor each item is on. It can also reduce cost for customers who would otherwise need a separate system for each floor.

In the Company's testing in multi-floor buildings, the capability accurately detected the correct floor. Performance varies with building type, conditions and device type. Organisations can contact Inturai to switch on floor-level sensing at their existing sites, and further updates will be provided as material developments occur.

VANCOUVER, BC, Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. ("Metalla" or the "Company") (NYSE American: MTA) (TSXV: MTA) announces that the board of directors of Metalla (the "Board") has approved the adoption of a shareholder rights plan (the "Rights Plan"), effective as of November 26, 2026 (the "Effective Date"), pursuant to a shareholder rights plan agreement entered into with Odyssey Trust Company, as rights agent.

The Rights Plan is consistent with shareholder rights plans adopted by other Canadian public companies and is intended to promote the fair treatment of all shareholders in the event of a take-over bid and to protect against "creeping bids," which may result in the accumulation of 20% or more of the Company's common shares outside the formal take-over bid process. The Rights Plan has not been implemented in response to any specific proposal to acquire control of the Company and the Board is not aware of any pending or threatened take-over bid for the Company.

Pursuant to the Rights Plan, one right was issued and attached to each common share of the Company outstanding as of the effective time of the Rights Plan. A right will also be attached to each common share issued after the Effective Date in accordance with the terms of the Rights Plan. The issuance of the rights will not change the manner in which shareholders trade their common shares of Metalla and the rights will automatically attach to the common shares with no further action by shareholders being required. Subject to the terms of the Rights Plan, the rights become exercisable in the event that any person (including associates and affiliates and persons acting in concert) becomes a beneficial holder of 20% or more of Metalla's outstanding common shares, without complying with the "Permitted Bid" provisions under the Rights Plan. In such event, holders of the rights (other than the acquiring person and its related parties) will be permitted to exercise their rights to purchase additional common shares of the Company at a substantial discount to the then market price of the Company's common shares.

The Rights Plan is subject to acceptance by the TSX Venture Exchange and to ratification by shareholders of the Company within six months of its adoption. If shareholders do not ratify the Rights Plan within that period, the Rights Plan and all rights issued under it will terminate. The Company will seek shareholder ratification of the Rights Plan, and a summary of its principal terms will be included in the management information circular to be delivered to shareholders and a complete copy of the Rights Plan will be filed under the Company's profile on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca and on EDGAR at www.sec.gov/edgar.

Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - TruSilver Metals Corp. The Company's common shares will continue to trade on the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol "TAG".

The OTCQB is a U.S. trading venue for entrepreneurial and development-stage companies. To qualify, companies must be current in their reporting and pass an annual verification and management certification process. The listing gives U.S. investors a simple way to buy and hold TruSilver shares through their existing brokerage accounts, in U.S. dollars and during U.S. market hours.

Highlights

  • Three markets in one month. TruSilver began trading on the TSX Venture Exchange on October 27, 2026, on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange on November 10, 2026 (FSE: XJ10; WKN: A42QTR), and now on the OTCQB.

  • Broader investor reach. The OTCQB listing opens TruSilver to U.S. retail and institutional investors, alongside its existing Canadian and European shareholder base.

  • Drilling at Sturgis-Walton. TruSilver's planned 2026/27 diamond drilling program of approximately 3,500 metres across five holes is commencing with hole ST-26-01A at its 100%-owned Sturgis-Walton Silver Project, adjacent to the historic Walton Mine.

Michael Gross, President and Chief Executive Officer of TruSilver, commented:

"Adding the OTCQB means investors in Canada, Europe and the United States can now own TruSilver on a market close to home. The U.S. has one of the deepest pools of capital for silver and precious-metals explorers anywhere, and we want those investors following our story from the start. That story is about to be tested with the drill. Sturgis-Walton sits next to one of the historic highest-grade silver mines in Nova Scotia's history, and our geophysics points to a target at depth that has never been properly drilled. Over the coming months our job is simple: drill it, report what we find, and keep our shareholders informed every step of the way."

TruSilver Metals Corp. owns 100% of the Sturgis-Walton Silver Project in Hants County, Nova Scotia, free of a net smelter return royalty, adjacent to the historic Walton Mine, a past barite producer and silver-rich lead-zinc-copper mine, where historical sources report mined ore head grades of 350-933 g/t silver (Ag).¹ TruSilver is commencing drilling of hole ST-26-01A, the first hole of its 2026/27 drill program, aimed squarely at the Sturgis Target: a large, dense and electrically conductive body approximately 1.5 km south of the Walton Mine. The Sturgis Target is where five years of magnetic, audio-magnetotelluric (AMT) and gravity surveys, drilling and 3D modelling converge. The Company's working hypothesis, which this program is designed to test, is that the Sturgis Target may represent a somewhat deeper and along-strike part of the same mineralizing system that formed the Walton Mine. A drilling permit is in place. TruSilver's 2023 hole, ST-23-001 (collared approximately 850 m from the mine), was drilled between the Walton Mine and the newer Sturgis Target, and returned 48.8 g/t silver and 0.19% copper over 19.0 metres in the Macumber Formation, the rock unit that hosted mineralization at the Walton Mine, potentially indicating distal lower-grade mineralization between the two zones.² In late 2025, Rio Tinto Exploration Canada Inc. staked all open mineral claims in the Minas sub-basin, comprising 2,363 claims under 30 exploration licences, surrounding the Sturgis-Walton Silver Project. Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - The Precision Peptide Company (CSE: BPC) (OTCQB: PNGAF) (the "Company"), a publicly traded wellness company focused on advanced peptide formulations and delivery systems, today announced that its tirzepatide and GLP3 transdermal patches have each passed formal U.S. testing and that it has ordered 20,000 units of each from its exclusive U.S. manufacturer. 100% Tested and Manufactured in the United States

TA1 followed with a 20,000-unit order at 2 mg per patch. Tirzepatide and GLP3 have now cleared the same stage. Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Railtown AI Technologies Inc. (CSE: RAIL) (OTCQB: RLAIF) ("Railtown" or the "Company") today announced new on-demand model evaluation capabilities that use data captured from actual agent runs to compare alternative AI models. The technology extends Railtown's agent observability capabilities and helps developers and enterprises assess whether a lower-cost model or a different deployment environment can meet an application's quality and reliability requirements.

Evaluating Models Against Real Application Workloads

Railtown's agent observability technology can run locally or through its Conductr cloud platform, giving developers visibility into agent execution across development and production environments. The new capabilities use historical execution data to evaluate alternative models against real application workloads.

Developers can use these evaluations to identify tasks that may run on smaller, more efficient models, assess whether suitable workloads can move to a device or privately controlled infrastructure, and reduce reliance on any one provider. As new models become available, teams can revisit model choices throughout an application's life.

Evaluating Models in Apple's AI Ecosystem

Combining the new evaluation capabilities with Railtown's open-source Railtracks Swift Agent Development Kit (ADK) and agent observability gives Apple developers a way to assess which workloads could run on Apple's on-device foundation models or on a model running on Apple's Private Cloud Compute, where available.

Moving suitable tasks to an on-device model can reduce external inference costs, keep those model requests on the device and enable offline functionality where supported. Eligible developers can also evaluate Apple's cloud-hosted model for tasks that need more reasoning capacity or a larger context window.

"Developers should be able to look at the work their agents already do and ask where a smaller model can deliver the quality they need," said Marwan Haddad, CTO and Co-Founder of Railtown AI. "For an Apple developer, that might mean moving part of a workflow onto the device. For an enterprise, it might mean running a model on infrastructure it controls. In both cases, the decision starts with data from the application itself."

Supporting Private and Sovereign AI Deployments

Enterprises and governments seeking greater control over sensitive data and intellectual property can use the technology to assess whether open-weight models running on infrastructure they control meet the requirements of existing applications.

In Canada, Railtown sees an opportunity to complement investment in sovereign AI infrastructure by helping organizations identify which workloads can move to domestically controlled computing environments and what changes those workloads may require.

The new capabilities extend Railtown's agent development tools, which include the open-source Railtracks Swift and Python ADKs, knowledge retrieval technology, agent observability and the Conductr platform. The Company is also exploring ways to build on its observability and evaluation technology to help developers optimize prompts and agent workflows.

Railtown expects to make the evaluation capabilities available to developers soon and plans to publish a technical blog demonstrating how to use them.

Its technology includes Conductr, an agentic AI orchestration, deployment and observability platform; Railengine, its knowledge and data infrastructure; and Railtracks, its open-source Agent Development Kit.

DUBLIN, IE / ACCESS Newswire / November 27, 2026 / Great Western Mining Corporation PLC (AIM:GWMO)(Euronext Growth:8GW)(OTCQB:GWMOF), a strategic minerals exploration and development company, is pleased to provide an update on its Defender Tungsten Project ("Defender" or the "Project") in Mineral County, Nevada, USA, following the identification of a newly discovered adit approximately 400m west of the historical Widowmaker Mine. The Company has named this the Starry Night Mine ("Starry Night") and intends to prioritise sampling work there as part of its next phase of fieldwork in the coming weeks.

Starry Night Mine

Starry Night was identified by the Company's technical team during recent reconnaissance work at Defender and initial field observations, including shortwave ultraviolet ("SWUV") inspection, have identified approximately 50m of scheelite-bearing garnet skarn mineralisation along the adit.

As announced on 7 July 2026, it is theorised that a 3km skarn trend extends from the Defender Mine through the Pine Crow and Widowmaker Mines to the Company's JORC-compliant M2 skarn copper resource. As described in the Company's announcement of 18 August 2026, the Project comprises the historical Widowmaker, Pine Crow, Dough God and Defender tungsten mines, located along a >2km mineralised corridor within the total 3km mineralised trend running from Defender to the M2 resource.

Located west of Widowmaker, Starry Night has the potential to extend the Project's tungsten strike from approximately 2km to approximately 2.4km and lies along the 3km trend linking the Project to the M2 resource 600m away.

The Company intends to prioritise channel sampling at Starry Night and further updates will reported as results are received.

Figure 1: Location of the Starry Night Mine and extension of identified strike towards the M2 copper resource in the west.

Drill Assays and Maiden Mineral Resource Estimate

As announced on 23 September 2026, the Company completed a 23-hole reverse circulation drilling programme for approximately 8,500 ft (2,590 m) at Defender, with all samples dispatched to American Assay in Reno, Nevada. Assay results were expected in Q4 2026 however processing has since been delayed by laboratory capacity constraints affecting the region, and results are still outstanding.

Addison Mining Services ("Addison"), the independent Competent Person engaged to prepare the maiden JORC Mineral Resource Estimate ("MRE"), has been closely involved in the programme to date, including supervising the drilling. The Company therefore expects to be well positioned to progress the MRE promptly once assays are received.

Ed Loye, CEO of Great Western, commented: "Identifying Starry Night, a historical mine adit west of Widowmaker, is another very encouraging development for Defender. It has the potential to extend our tungsten strike to around 2.4km and adds a further valuable data point along the trend towards our M2 resource. We intend to prioritise sampling at Starry Night, and the team are keen to get on site as soon as possible, whilst noting winter weather conditions.

"The delay to our drill assays is frustrating, but not unique to Great Western. Laboratory capacity constraints are affecting the industry across the region and are a symptom of the current buoyant mining landscape in Nevada. Addison has been closely involved since before drilling began, which puts us in a good position to move quickly once results are received. The assays and maiden resource are expected to give us a much fuller picture of our opportunity at Defender as we look towards mine development."

This press release should be read in conjunction with the Company's Report on Form 6-K for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, which has been furnished to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and is available on the SEC's website at www.sec.gov and on the Company's investor relations website at http://ir.xiaoyinggroup.com.

Third Quarter 2026 Financial and Operational Highlights

  • Total net revenue in Q3 2026 was RMB771.5 million (US$115.1 million), a decrease of 60.7% year-over-year and 22.4% quarter-over-quarter. The year-over-year decline was mainly attributable to substantially lower loan facilitation volumes, which reduced loan facilitation service revenue and post-origination service revenue, as well as lower financing income.
  • Total loan amount facilitated and originated[1] in Q3 2026 was RMB4.35 billion, down 62.6% quarter-over-quarter and down 87.1% year-over-year.
  • Net loss in Q3 2026 was RMB159.6 million (US$23.8 million), compared with net income of RMB421.2 million a year ago and RMB47.0 million in Q2 2026, primarily reflecting income tax expense of RMB184.6 million and a loss from equity in affiliates, net of tax, of RMB70.9 million, which together exceeded income before income taxes of RMB101.9 million.
  • Delinquency rates for loans 31–60 days past due increased to 2.40% (from 1.73% at the end of Q2 2026 and 1.85% a year ago); loans 91–180 days past due declined to 7.83% (from 9.09% at the end of Q2 2026, though up from 3.52% a year ago). The 31–60 day delinquency rate increased both sequentially and year-over-year, indicating that credit trends deteriorated during the quarter, and the 91–180 day delinquency rate, while lower sequentially, remained materially above the prior-year level. During the quarter, the Company observed an increase in the 31–60 day delinquency rate, which may continue in the near term. The Company believes these trends are consistent with broader industry patterns.

Mr. Kent Li, President of X Financial, commented: "In the third quarter of 2026, we facilitated and originated RMB4.3 billion in loans, a decline of 62.6% from the prior quarter and 87.1% year-over-year. Borrower activity continued to contract, with active borrowers declining to approximately 290,269, down 88.1% from a year ago, while the average loan amount per transaction decreased 5.7% quarter-over-quarter to RMB11,983. The 31–60 day delinquency rate increased to 2.40% from 1.73% in the prior quarter, while the 91–180 day rate eased to 7.83% from 9.09%. The increase in the 31–60 day delinquency rate indicates that credit trends deteriorated during the quarter and may continue in the near term, and both delinquency rates remained above prior-year levels. We believe these trends are consistent with broader industry patterns. We therefore continue to prioritize disciplined underwriting, collection effectiveness, and conservative capital deployment. While the business remains under pressure from lower origination volumes and a challenging credit environment, our focus remains on preserving balance sheet resilience and operating flexibility."

Mr. Frank Fuya Zheng, Chief Financial Officer of X Financial, added: "In the third quarter of 2026, total net revenue was RMB771.5 million, a decrease of 60.7% from the same period last year and 22.4% sequentially. Net loss was RMB159.6 million and non-GAAP adjusted net loss was RMB152.2 million, compared with net income of RMB47.0 million and non-GAAP adjusted net income of RMB165.8 million in the prior quarter. Basic loss per ADS was RMB4.38, and non-GAAP adjusted basic loss per ADS was RMB4.14. Operating margin decreased to 11.8% from 19.6% in the prior quarter and from 18.5% in the same period of 2025. We will continue to manage capital conservatively, maintain cost discipline, and preserve liquidity as we navigate the evolving regulatory and operating environment."
